purpose: Document first-party local registry/viewer evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Static HTML, map page, configuration and main JavaScript bundle for the official Anyang Tianditu viewer were inspected. The viewer config contains a public embedded map API credential; its value was excluded from retained notes. The inspected bundle/config exposes basemap/thematic map behavior and no parcel/cadastral layer or feature-query endpoint. No geometry query was sent. Whether a separate authenticated or non-public cadastral interface exists, and whether any untraced public layer covers the WUP locator.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Anyang Tianditu public map operated by Anyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau; listed content is general basemap/thematic mapping, not cadastral parcels.
Official map contact page identifies the Anyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as owner/operator.
Official procurement portal results identify a municipal Anyang Real Estate Transaction and Registration Center.

attempts.method: GET official page and static viewer assets
attempts.result: Page and viewer bundle/config inspected; general public map services, no parcel layer identified.

attempts.result: City Real Estate Transaction and Registration Center identified; no geometry endpoint.
